I booked Hotel Shree Kanta after seeing nice photos on Google, but the reality was completely different. The rooms looked decent online, but when I arrived, everything was dirty and poorly

I rarely leave reviews, but my stay at Hotel Shree Kanta was so terrible, I had to warn others.

Dirty Rooms: The room was filthy — stained bedsheets, dust everywhere, and the bathroom smelled like it hadn’t been cleaned in weeks.

Rude Staff: The staff were extremely unprofessional and unhelpful. Every request felt like a burden to them. No courtesy, no manners.

No Basic Facilities: No hot water, broken AC, and the Wi-Fi didn’t work at all. They advertise all these amenities, but nothing was functional.

Noisy & Unsafe: It was noisy all night due to street traffic and loud guests. Security felt non-existent — the doors barely locked properly.

Terrible Food: The food was stale and tasteless. I got an upset stomach after eating their so-called "fresh" meal.

Honestly, this place doesn’t even deserve 1 star. Total waste of money. I regret booking it and would NEVER recommend it to anyone. Stay away from this hotel!

I chose Hotel Shree Kanta based on the beautiful pictures shown on Google, but the moment I stepped into the room, I realized I had made a big mistake.

The room was nothing like the photos — dirty floors, stained sheets, and a bathroom that smelled like it hadn’t been cleaned in days.

Walls were damp, paint was peeling, and everything looked old and uncared for.

It’s clear they only cleaned the room for the photo shoot — not for real guests.

The staff didn’t seem bothered when I complained. No apology, no solution.

If you care about hygiene and honesty, do not stay here. This was a waste of money and time. Totally disappointing.
